title: Independent public-case navigation coverage V17
description: Independently authored bilingual consumer and operational goals for every V17 public-service terminal, with jurisdictional, record, role, lifecycle, recovery, and user-controlled final-action boundaries.

authoring_policy.goals: Natural Korean and English work-purpose requests were written from the reviewed public source pack, not from production aliases, patterns, rules, runtime output, or sealed V16 evidence.
authoring_policy.semantics_only: No package name, resource identifier, coordinate, bound, screenshot fingerprint, fixed UI path, pixel, or recorded click sequence is present.
authoring_policy.fail_closed: Wrong role, record, jurisdiction, loading, offline, error, or expired-session states do not activate a target and remain at the domain hub until the user independently resolves and reverifies context.
authoring_policy.safety: Every sensitive read and consequential change stops with no_click before the final user-controlled action.
